title: Reorder payload
description: The payload of the reorder operation (L13): one item whose fractional index changes and the new value. The operation and its inverse both use this payload, the inverse carrying the previous z.

itemId.description: Reference to the reordered item: a card, a block or a zone of the board.

z.description: The fractional index of the item; lexicographic order, the highest value is on top of its layer (L13).
